title: Malicious code in chai-as-spy (npm)
description: The npm package 'chai-as-spy' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise includes potential unauthorized access to all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to the extent of the compromise, complete remediation cannot be guaranteed by removal alone. Secrets and keys should be rotated from a separate, uncompromised device.
